name: @structura/sim
description: Load simulator (Rust, compiled to WebAssembly). pkg/ is committed so builds without Rust (Netlify) still work; run build:wasm after changing src/.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg --no-pack && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('pkg/.gitignore', { force: true })"
